issuerName: CHICAGO ATLANTIC REAL ESTATE FINANCE, INC.

segments.name: real estate finance
segments.description: Originates and holds commercial real estate loans, mainly senior loans to state-licensed cannabis operators.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through a single operating and reporting segment with an investment objective to generate both current income and capital appreciation through its investments in loans.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on the loans the Company makes, mainly senior loans to state-licensed cannabis operators.
revenueModel.evidence: Our loans bear interest rates that are either fixed or determined periodically on the basis of U.S. Prime Rate ("Prime") or Secured Overnight Financing Rate ("SOFR") plus a premium.
